summary: Completed testing of Clara Health Modal features. All backend API tests passed (8/8). Frontend tests confirm: Modal appears centered with backdrop blur after admin login (8s delay), shows Clara branding header, displays overall AI diagnosis in amber box, shows per-issue cards with type badges and action buttons, Reconfigure navigates to correct settings page, Re-test calls API and shows updated diagnosis, all dismiss methods work (X, Dismiss, backdrop click), session storage prevents re-showing, and Rescan re-runs the full health scan.

issues: Console warnings about DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility - minor a11y issue
